result.summary: All four frozen final policies completed 20k fresh Slumbot hands each: S1 original -41.3261, half -31.1833; S3 original -17.1275, half -35.0108 bb/100. Independent raw review and 236985 decision replays passed; no winning policy or replicated LR winner.
result.conclusion: Half-minus-original is +10.1428 in Seed1 and -17.8833 in Seed3, both ordinary and multiplicity-adjusted intervals crossing zero. These directions agree with internal final contrasts but do not establish general proxy validity or model improvement. All four means are negative. Twenty thousand hands per policy and roughly2.1M full-scope training hands do not justify a universal family rejection.
